content.text:
I've changed the name from "Dainik Samachar" to "Newsly" across 67 files. Only text and names changed; no code logic was touched. `tsc --noEmit` reports no type errors, and no tests check for the old name. I haven't run the app or the test suite, and nothing is committed yet.

**What changed:**
- **What users see:** all page titles and descriptions, the header, footer, nav, about page, pricing, the Pro upgrade button and Razorpay checkout name, toasts, the API docs, OpenAPI title, the landing-page label (the Hindi "दैनिक समाचार" is gone too), and billing and API-key error messages.
- **Docs and comments:** `README.md`, `neatlogsHackathon.md`, `services/upstox/README.md`, code comments, the review prompts in `.entire/runners/*.json`, and the deploy workflow's display name. I also fixed the README table-of-contents link so it still points to the renamed "How Newsly Works" heading.
- **Component rename:** `DainikSamacharDashboardPage` is now `NewslyDashboardPage`, including the file, and `app/home/page.tsx` imports the new name.

**What I left alone, because changing it would affect how things run or break links:**
- GitHub and Entire repo URLs (`learner-enthusiast/dainikSamachar`). These are real links and break unless the repo itself is renamed.
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`: the server folder `/home/ubuntu/apps/dainikSamachar`, the pm2 process `dainiksamachar`, and the deploy group name. Renaming these would break deploys.
- The neatlogs tracing name `dainik-samachar` (`clients/neatlogsClient.ts`, `.env.example`). Changing it would split your traces in neatlogs.
- The OpenAPI document ID `urn:dainik-samachar:openapi`.
- The webhook `User-Agent: DainikSamachar-Webhooks/1`. Anyone receiving your webhooks may filter on it.
- The feed scraper's `User-Agent` (`DainikSamacharBot/1.0; +https://dainiksamachar.app`).
- The "Dainik Jagaran" email sender and domain in `.env.example`. That's a different name, so I didn't treat it as part of this rename.

I can rename any of those too, along with the server and pm2 setup if needed, or commit these changes. Just say which.
